judged_text: The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' spec drives remove_member with xhr :put even though config/routes.rb maps only DELETE /admin/groups/:group_id/members to remove_member, and controller specs bypass routing entirely. The automatic-group guard is verified through a request no real client can make; if the DELETE route is dropped or remapped, this acceptance test stays green while the actual endpoint 404s for every caller including the shipped UI.
